test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

The violation or profanation of anything sacred or held sacred
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Sacrilege'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate one-word** substitution for 'the violation or profanation of anything sacred or held sacred' is: **'Sacrilege'**
 
• **'Sacrilege' **refers to the violation or misuse of what is regarded as sacred.(पवित्रता का उल्लंघन)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Sacrilege'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are explanations for the rest of the words:
 
 
• **Pious - **showing reverence for a deity and devotion to the worship of a deity.(धार्मिक)
 
• **Sacramental -** relating to or constituting a sacrament, rite, or act of Christian worship.(संस्कार सम्बन्धी)
 
• **Holy -** dedicated or consecrated to God or a religious purpose; sacred.(पवित्र)
 
 

3f:Tac8,

The correct answer is 'Option 1'.</st
